title: Introducing GPT-5.2
summary: GPT-5.2 is our most advanced frontier model for everyday professional work, with state-of-the-art reasoning, long-context understanding, coding, and vision. Use it in ChatGPT and the OpenAI API to power faster, more reliable agentic workflows.
body: GPT-5.2 is our most advanced frontier model for everyday professional work, with state-of-the-art reasoning, long-context understanding, coding, and vision. Use it in ChatGPT and the OpenAI API to power faster, more reliable agentic workflows.
summaryZh: OpenAI推出GPT-5.2，定位为面向专业工作的最先进前沿模型。该模型在推理、长上下文理解、编码及视觉能力方面均有显著提升，旨在通过API和ChatGPT平台支持更高效、更可靠的代理工作流，推动AI从对话工具向自动化执行代理的转变。

aiReview.reasonZh: GPT-5.2的发布重点强调了其在代理工作流中的应用能力，是模型演进的重要方向。

glossary.explanationZh: 指AI模型能够自主规划、执行并协调多步骤任务的工作流程。
模型处理和理解超长文本输入的能力。
